sentences.text:
Adil Sajid Bhai @ Aadil Sheikh vs The State Of West Bengal &
Anr on 2 December, 2025

Sl. no. 29
Ct. No. 42
 P.M.
 Crr 4078 Of 2025
 Adil Sajid Bhai @ Aadil Sheikh
 - Vs -
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Sudipto Panda, Sr. adv.
 Ms. Salma Sultana Shah
 ....

Present petition has been filed for quashing of the Fir being Pragati Moidan Police Station Fir No.
79 of 2024 dated 11th May, 2024 arising out of Acgr No. 2604 of 2024 under Sections
498A/307/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in fact the opposite party misrepresented before
the petitioner and got married with him.

3.  Learned counsel submits that later on it transpired that opposite party No. 2 is a Bangladeshi citizen and is transgender.
4.
Learned counsel submits that the petitioner has already filed an application under Section 25 of the Special Marriage Act declaring the marriage and nullity.

Learned counsel has prayed for stay of the criminal proceedings against the petitioner.
5.
Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor.
Opposite party No. 2 be also served.

7. List this matter in the combined Monthly List of February, 2026.
8.
State is directed to produce the Case Diary.

9. In the meanwhile in view of the facts as explained above the proceedings against the petitioner in Adil Sajid Bhai @ Aadil Sheikh vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56119491/
